meta.name: Love J Action
meta.description: Love is not just blind, it chooses to be blind. Jackson gets the girl of his dreams against all odds, but when she betrays him, his obsession takes on a form so Machiavellian, even he can not predict how far he'll go.

videos.title: Nanhi Cheenti
videos.overview: Jai Kishan Awasthi, alias Jackson surrenders before UP police in mysterious circumstances. He has serious allegations of kidnapping Kamya Gupta, fiancé of Superintendent of Police Lucknow city, Abhay Anand.

videos.title: Mann Ka Vishwaas
videos.overview: Jackson tells SP Anand how he and Kamya eloped and how she died. But is it the complete truth or is there something more to it?

videos.title: Asaflta Ek Chunauti
videos.overview: The mystery deepens as layers unfold. There is more to be unveiled in Kamya’s disappearance case and some shocking revelations turn Jackson’s life upside down.

videos.title: Sangharsh Ka Maidaan
videos.overview: Jackson’s obsessive search for Kamya brings him to Delhi. He is ready to cross all milestones and reach out to her.

videos.title: Girkar Chadna
videos.overview: Jackson succeeds in spoiling Vikrant’s plans. But one small blunder by Jackson brings both Minty and SP Anand behind him.

videos.title: Jai Jai Kaar
videos.overview: The ground is set. Jackson is in the final round to prove his love for Kamya.
